schema.description: Normalized relative path; percent-encoded traversal, NUL, backslash, absolute, and parent components are rejected.

IfMatch.description: A single strong entity-tag. Plan and staged-content routes use the quoted session version (for example, "1"); later lifecycle routes use the persisted plan hash.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

RequestHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialized typed payload; it must exactly equal MutationRequest.request_hash.
RequestHash.name: X-Request-Hash

schema.description: Normalized relative path; percent-encoded traversal, NUL, backslash, absolute, and parent components are rejected.

StagedClassification.description: Closed content classification. State, secret, and unknown content cannot be staged.
StagedClassification.name: x-kitsunebi-classification

Permission.description: Explicit action grant. Role labels do not grant an action without this value and an object/service scope.

cloudflareAccess.description: Cloudflare Access RS256 JWT assertion. Cookie and bearer fallbacks are not accepted. The origin validates issuer, audience, exp/nbf/iat, kid, and the rotated JWKS before mapping the subject through the persisted actor identity and access-policy port; roles and service scopes are never inferred from JWT claims.
cloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion

post.summary: Stage content in a change session

get.description: WebSocket relay to the server-side ConsoleSession port. The browser never receives GameAP credentials, frames are bounded, and audit records contain only direction, size, and digest.
Detailed GameAP, backup, monitoring, DNS, and TCPShield dependency health. This endpoint is authenticated; public /health and /ready remain shallow probes.
Operation-specific server-sent events. The authenticated actor and service scope are checked before the stream opens; the stream expires after the bounded lifetime or idle period.

post.description: Returns a short-lived synchronizer token for the authenticated browser actor. Service actors are not eligible, and the request must carry one allowed Origin.
